entries.zh: 木头 橡木 玻璃 污玻璃 金属 铁 钢 青铜 古老的正面 背面 侧面

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Led to a door with stained-glass panels

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Led from the yard into the main part of the house
entries.zh: 从院子里走进房子的主要部分

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Opened out onto a large hall

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The entrance was blocked by a metal gate carved with ancient symbols.
entries.zh: 入口被刻有古代符号的金属门堵塞.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The heavy, metal door opened out onto a vast, wood-panelled hall.
entries.zh: 这扇重金属门打开了 一个宽阔的木板大厅

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The front step was set deep in the wall and led to a door with stained-glass panels.
entries.zh: 前台阶被设置在墙壁深处,并导致一扇带有污玻璃板的门.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: A steel-shuttered door towered above them and rattled in the wind.
entries.zh: 一扇钢制的门 塔在他们上面,在风中摇晃。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: They went through a heavy, oak door, which led from the courtyard into the main part of the house.
entries.zh: 他们穿过一个沉重的橡树门,从院子里引向了房子的主要部分.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Where the path ended, they were faced by a low, ancient-looking door studded with sharp, black nails.
entries.zh: 道路尽头时,他们面对着一个低矮、古老的门,门顶着尖锐的黑色钉子。

entries.label: Nouns
entries.en: Entrance, hall, hallway, corridor, steps, stairs, staircase
entries.zh: 入口、大厅、走廊、走廊、台阶、楼梯、楼梯

entries.label: Adjectives
entries.en: Dark, dimly lit, gloomy, eerie, draughty, echoing
entries.zh: 黑暗 暗淡 阴暗 阴沉 阴沉 阴沉 阴沉

entries.label: Adjectives
entries.en: White, cream, red, wooden, stone, marble
entries.zh: 白色、奶油、红色、木质、石头、大理石

entries.label: Verbs
entries.zh: 高声回响 高声回响

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Ahead was a flight of stairs

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Led up to the first floor

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.zh: 进入了宽阔的入口大厅

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Swept dramatically down to the entrance hall

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Steeped in a thick, eerie darkness

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Wind tore through the draughty corridor

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The door opened onto a long, dimly lit corridor.
entries.zh: 门打开了一条长长的、明亮的走廊。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The wooden stairs spiralled their way to the rooms upstairs.
entries.zh: 木制楼梯螺旋式地走进楼上的房间.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The glass doors opened out onto a lobby of polished white marble.
entries.zh: 玻璃门打开了 一块被抛光的白色大理石的大厅

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Her feet sunk into the luxurious red carpet.
entries.zh: 她的脚沉入豪华的红地毯中.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The wide staircase swept dramatically down to the entrance hall.
entries.zh: 宽的楼梯大幅扫到入口大厅.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: They went up the stone steps into the vast, echoing entrance hall.
entries.zh: 他们爬上石阶,进入宽阔的,呼应的入口大厅.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: She was faced with a long corridor steeped in a thick, eerie darkness.
entries.zh: 她面对着一条长长的走廊, 陡峭的黑暗中,

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He had entered a narrow hallway and ahead of him was a flight of stairs leading up to the first floor.
entries.zh: 他走进狭窄的走廊,前面是通往一楼的楼梯。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: A bitter wind tore through the draughty corridors and rattled the windows.
entries.zh: 一阵苦风撕裂了 干燥的走廊 并搅乱了窗户。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The staircase was dark and gloomy and every step she took was followed by a creaking echo.
entries.zh: 楼梯阴暗阴暗,她走的每一步都伴有震撼的回声.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The spiral stairs twisted and turned sharply, changing direction at every corner.
entries.zh: 螺旋式楼梯扭曲并急剧转向,每个转角的方向都发生了变化.
